```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

database_path <- "{{database}}"
top_n <- as.integer("{{top_n}}")

drv <- duckdb()
con <- dbConnect(drv, dbdir = database_path, read_only = TRUE)

kpis <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM kpi_summary")
trend <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM monthly_trend ORDER BY month")
pivot <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM region_category_pivot ORDER BY total_revenue DESC")
products <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "SELECT * FROM product_ranking ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT %d",
    top_n
  )
)
```

## 核心指标

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(
  '<div class="kpi-grid">',
  sprintf('<div class="kpi"><span>订单数</span><strong>%s</strong></div>',
          comma(kpis$orders)),
  sprintf('<div class="kpi"><span>客户数</span><strong>%s</strong></div>',
          comma(kpis$customers)),
  sprintf('<div class="kpi"><span>销售收入</span><strong>¥%s</strong></div>',
          comma(kpis$revenue)),
  sprintf('<div class="kpi"><span>毛利率</span><strong>%.2f%%</strong></div>',
          kpis$margin_pct),
  "</div>",
  sep = ""
)
```

## 月度趋势

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "月度销售收入"
trend |>
  mutate(month = as.Date(month)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = revenue)) +
  geom_line(color = "#b86316", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#b86316", size = 2.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
  scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%Y-%m")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "收入") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "{{report_font}}") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```

## 区域 × 品类透视

```{r}
#| label: pivot-table
knitr::kable(
  pivot,
  format = if (knitr::is_html_output()) "html" else "pipe",
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("区域", "办公家具", "电子设备", "办公用品",
                "总收入", "毛利", "毛利率%")
)
```

## 重点产品

```{r}
#| label: product-table
knitr::kable(
  products,
  format = if (knitr::is_html_output()) "html" else "pipe",
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("产品", "品类", "数量", "收入", "毛利", "毛利率%")
)
```

## 结论

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf(
  "收入最高区域是 **%s**，收入 **¥%s**；排名第一的产品是 **%s**，贡献收入 **¥%s**。",
  pivot$region[1], comma(pivot$total_revenue[1]),
  products$product_name[1], comma(products$revenue[1])
))
```

```{r}
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
